title: Claude Code 03: .claude folder me kaun si files hoti hain
description:
Claude Code 03: .claude folder. Claude Code apni instructions, settings, skills, subagents aur memory do jagah se padhta hai: project ka .claude folder (git me commit, team ke saath share) aur home folder ka .claude (sirf aapke liye). Zyadatar log sirf CLAUDE.md aur settings.json badalte hain. Video me: terminal demo (ls .claude, settings.json permissions, CLAUDE.md me tests ki command), kaun si baat kis file me jaye (CLAUDE.md, settings.json, .mcp.json, settings.local.json), optional folders (skills, agents, rules, output-styles), CLAUDE.local.md aur AGENTS.md, managed settings, aur chetavni: transcripts plain text me hote hain (.env ki value bhi ja sakti hai), 30 din baad auto delete, claude purge ko pehle --dry-run se chalao, aur claude.json, settings.json, plugins kabhi delete mat karo.

Source (official):
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-directory

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the terminal and file screens in this video are our own illustration (not a recording); the settings.json content is an example. Synthetic voice.
